name: symbols
description: List all trading pair symbols available on the Gemini (US-regulated) exchange (e.g. btcusd, ethusd). Use as a directory before other Gemini tools.

name: symbol_details
description: Fetch trading pair metadata from Gemini for a symbol: base/quote currency, tick size, quote increment, min order size, and status.

name: ticker
description: Gemini crypto exchange (US-regulated) v1 ticker for a crypto pair like "btcusd": bid, ask, last, 24h volume. Use for current Gemini pricing.

name: ticker_v2
description: Gemini crypto exchange v2 ticker with 24-hour rolling stats: open, high, low, last, changes, bid/ask, hourly closes. Use for daily summary on Gemini-listed pairs.

name: candles
description: Gemini crypto exchange OHLC candles for a crypto pair. Time frames 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1hr, 6hr, 1day. Use for charting and backtesting on Gemini.

name: book
description: Gemini crypto exchange (US-regulated) order book for a crypto pair: bids + asks with price, amount, timestamp. Use for live depth-of-book on Gemini-listed pairs.

name: trades
description: Fetch recent trade history from Gemini for a symbol; optional timestamp filters to a start time and limit_trades caps the result count. Returns price, amount, type, and timestamp per trade.

name: price_feed
description: Gemini crypto exchange — all listed pair prices in one snapshot: pair, price, 24h change percent. Use for cross-pair scan or fast latest-price across many tokens.

name: network
description: Return the blockchain network name for a Gemini-listed token (e.g. btc → bitcoin, eth → ethereum). Use to resolve deposit/withdrawal network before on-chain operations.

name: gas_fees
description: Fetch estimated on-chain gas fees from Gemini for a symbol (e.g. ethusd): fee amount and unit. Use before estimating ETH withdrawal costs.
